That flags the manual memory management warnings in clang.  We could explicitly ignore them, but this seemed better, even if it's tougher to read?

If you think NOLINT + the normal free call is better, I can make that change.
No, this is good.  Any chance of cursor being `nullptr` if `sd_journal_get_cursor()` returns successfully?  I think constructing `std::string` from `nullptr` is UB.
According to the docs it can't, but that's a fair ask, lets keep the static analyzers from working too hard.  Added a nullptr check.
